# Card updater task

Task 88 FIRMUP_CLI: picks the DCOLYMP E142????.BIN with the largest suffix above 0.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60c95bab` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md)

E1429999.BIN is chosen and E1420000.BIN never is. FIRMUP_SRV starts only after section 2 has loaded, so an early boot fault could make the updater unreachable.

## Observations

- **Emulator** ([Caduceus for E-P7](../projects/caduceus-ep7.md)): File selection verified in the emulator. Source: [E-P7 firmware guide](../sources/ep7.guide.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for E-P7](../projects/caduceus-ep7.md)): Recovered the E-P7 once from a boot loop. Source: [E-P7 firmware guide](../sources/ep7.guide.md).
